order_drink.text: {npc} orders a mug at the bar and settles in with it.

serve_order.text: {npc} waves you over, orders a drink and presses a tip into your hand.

watch_dancer.text: {npc} watches you dance, claps once and tosses you a coin.

milk_barrel.text: {npc} stops at your barrel, fills a mug and drinks it slowly. 'Fresh, dear.'
